html_mcq_questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language, which is the standard markup language for creating web pages.

html_mcq_questions.question: Who is the inventor of HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Tim Berners-Lee invented HTML in 1989 while working at CERN.

html_mcq_questions.question: HTML files are saved with which file extension?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: HTML files use either .htm or .html file extensions.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag defines the root of an HTML document?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [html] tag defines the root of an HTML document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to display a horizontal line in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [hr] tag creates a horizontal line in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which HTML element is used to define a paragraph?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [p] tag defines a paragraph in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to insert a line break?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [br] tag inserts a single line break in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: HTML is a:
html_mcq_questions.explanation: HTML is a Markup Language used for structuring and presenting content on the web.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag defines the title of an HTML document?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [title] tag defines the title of the HTML document which appears in the browser's title bar or tab.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to create a hyperlink in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [a] tag creates hyperlinks in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the [!DOCTYPE] declaration?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [!DOCTYPE] declaration specifies the document type and HTML version, helping browsers render the page correctly.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which HTML element contains metadata about the document?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [head] element contains metadata about the document, including title, styles, scripts, and meta information.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the correct way to comment in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: HTML comments are written using [!-- comment text --].

html_mcq_questions.question: Which character encoding is recommended for HTML5?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: UTF-8 is the recommended character encoding for HTML5 as it supports all Unicode characters.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the lang attribute in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The lang attribute specifies the language of the document content.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to define the largest heading in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [h1] tag defines the largest and most important heading in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to define a paragraph in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [p] tag defines a paragraph in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to make text bold in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Both [strong] and [b] tags can be used to make text bold in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to insert an image in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [img] tag is used to embed images in HTML documents.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used with [img] to specify the image path?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The src attribute specifies the path (URL) to the image.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to create an unordered list?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [ul] tag creates an unordered (bulleted) list.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to create a list item?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [li] tag defines a list item within ordered or unordered lists.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to insert a line horizontally?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [hr] tag creates a horizontal line in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the [em] tag?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [em] tag renders text in italic and emphasizes it.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to define a hyperlink in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [a] tag creates hyperlinks in HTML documents.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to define a hyperlink?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [a] tag defines a hyperlink in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to specify the URL in an anchor ([a]) tag?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The href attribute specifies the URL of the page the link goes to.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to embed an image in an HTML page?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [img] tag is used to embed images in HTML documents.

html_mcq_questions.question: What attribute is used to specify the path of an image in [img] tag?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The src attribute specifies the path to the image file.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute provides alternative text for an image if it cannot be displayed?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The alt attribute provides alternative text for an image if it cannot be displayed.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to open a hyperlink in a new tab?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The target="_blank" attribute opens the linked document in a new window or tab.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the correct way to display an image that is located in a folder named "images"?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Use the src attribute with the correct path to display an image from a folder.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to create clickable image links?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Wrap an [img] tag inside an [a] tag to create a clickable image link.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to provide a tooltip text when hovering over an image?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The title attribute shows tooltip text when hovering over an element.

html_mcq_questions.question: How can you link to a section within the same page?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Use href="#sectionID" to create an internal link to a section with the corresponding ID.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to define a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [table] tag defines an HTML table.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to define a row in a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [tr] tag defines a row in an HTML table.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag defines a header cell in a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [th] tag defines a header cell in an HTML table.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag defines a standard data cell in a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [td] tag defines a standard data cell in an HTML table.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the [caption] tag in an HTML table?

options.b: Adds a title to the table

html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [caption] tag defines a table caption or title.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag groups the header content in a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [thead] tag groups the header content in an HTML table.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag groups the footer content in a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [tfoot] tag groups the footer content in an HTML table.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag groups the main body content of a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [tbody] tag groups the body content in an HTML table.

html_mcq_questions.question: What attribute is used to merge two or more columns in a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The colspan attribute specifies the number of columns a cell should span.

html_mcq_questions.question: What attribute is used to merge two or more rows in a table?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The rowspan attribute specifies the number of rows a cell should span.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to create a form?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [form] tag is used to create an HTML form for user input.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies where to send the form data after submission?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The action attribute specifies where to send the form data when submitted.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute defines the HTTP method to be used when submitting the form?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The method attribute specifies the HTTP method (GET or POST) to be used when submitting the form.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to define a single-line input field?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [input] tag is used to create various types of input fields, including single-line text inputs.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to define the type of input field?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The type attribute specifies what kind of input field to display.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for creating a password field?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The password input type creates a field where characters are masked for security.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to create a drop-down list?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [select] tag creates a drop-down list.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to define options inside a drop-down list?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [option] tag defines an option in a select list.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to group related elements inside a form?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [fieldset] tag groups related form elements together.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag provides a caption for a [fieldset] element?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [legend] tag defines a caption for the [fieldset] element.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the required attribute in form elements?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The required attribute specifies that an input field must be filled out before submitting the form.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for email addresses?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The email input type is used for fields that should contain an email address.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to specify a maximum value for a number input?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The max attribute specifies the maximum value allowed in a number input field.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type creates a date picker?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The date input type creates a date picker control.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the placeholder attribute?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The placeholder attribute shows hint text in an input field before the user enters a value.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of semantic HTML?

options.a: To make the code look prettier
options.b: To provide meaning to the content

html_mcq_questions.explanation: Semantic HTML provides meaning to the content structure, making it more accessible and SEO-friendly.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to define the main content area of a webpage?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [main] tag specifies the main content area of a document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used for navigation links?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [nav] tag defines a section of navigation links.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag represents a standalone section of content?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [article] tag represents a self-contained composition in a document.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the [aside] tag?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [aside] tag defines content aside from the main content, like a sidebar.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to embed video content?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [video] tag is used to embed video content in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute in the video tag makes video controls visible?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The controls attribute adds video controls like play, pause, and volume.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag is used to embed audio content?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [audio] tag is used to embed sound content in HTML.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute makes audio or video play automatically?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The autoplay attribute starts playing audio/video automatically when the page loads.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute loops the audio/video content?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The loop attribute makes the audio/video content play repeatedly.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the HTML entity for copyright symbol?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: © displays the copyright symbol (©).

html_mcq_questions.question: Which entity is used to display the less than symbol ([)?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: < displays the less than symbol ([).

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the entity for non-breaking space?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: creates a non-breaking space that won't wrap to a new line.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which entity represents the ampersand (&)?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: & displays the ampersand symbol (&).

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the entity for the euro symbol (€)?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: € displays the euro symbol (€).

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of an iframe?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: An iframe (inline frame) is used to embed another document within the current HTML document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies the URL of the page to embed in an iframe?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The src attribute specifies the URL of the page to embed in an iframe.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to remove the border around an iframe?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The frameborder="0" attribute removes the border around an iframe.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies the name of an iframe?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The name attribute specifies a name for an iframe, which can be used as a target for links.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute controls iframe scrolling?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The scrolling attribute controls whether scrollbars appear in an iframe.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of meta tags in HTML?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Meta tags provide metadata about the HTML document such as description, keywords, author, etc.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag defines the character encoding for the HTML document?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The charset meta tag specifies the character encoding for the HTML document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag is used for responsive design?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The viewport meta tag is used to control the viewport's size and scale on mobile devices.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag defines a description of your web page?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The description meta tag provides a description of the page for search engines.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag defines keywords for search engines?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The keywords meta tag specifies keywords for search engines to use.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for color selection?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The color input type creates a color picker control.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type creates a slider control?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The range input type creates a slider control for number input.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to specify a regular expression for input validation?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The pattern attribute specifies a regular expression to validate input.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for telephone numbers?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The tel input type is used for input fields that should contain a telephone number.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies autocomplete suggestions?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The autocomplete attribute specifies whether a form or input field should have autocomplete enabled.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the alt attribute in images?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The alt attribute provides alternative text for users who cannot see the image.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to define keyboard shortcuts?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The accesskey attribute specifies a keyboard shortcut for an element.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the tabindex attribute?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The tabindex attribute specifies the tab order of an element.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute provides additional information about an element?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The aria-label attribute provides a label for screen readers.

html_mcq_questions.question: What is the purpose of the role attribute?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The role attribute defines the purpose of an element for accessibility.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for drag and drop functionality?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The HTML5 Drag and Drop API enables drag and drop functionality.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute makes an element draggable?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The draggable attribute specifies whether an element is draggable.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for storing data locally?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Web Storage API is used for storing data locally in the browser.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for getting the user's location?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Geolocation API is used to get the user's geographical location.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for drawing graphics?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Canvas API is used for drawing graphics on a web page.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element is used to play video files?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [video] element is used to embed video content.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents a progress bar?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [progress] element represents the progress of a task.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element is used for user-editable content?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The contenteditable attribute makes content editable by the user.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute is used to specify custom data attributes?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Data attributes (data-*) are used to store custom data within HTML elements.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element is used to draw graphics?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [canvas] element is used to draw graphics via JavaScript.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element is used for navigation?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [nav] element defines a set of navigation links.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element defines a header section?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [header] element defines a header section for a document or section.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element defines a footer section?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [footer] element defines a footer section for a document or section.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents a self-contained composition?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [article] element represents a self-contained composition in a document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element defines a section in a document?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [section] element defines a section in a document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents a generic container?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [div] element is a generic container for flow content.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents complementary content?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [aside] element represents content that is tangentially related to the content around it.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents a figure with optional caption?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [figure] element represents self-contained content, often with a caption ([figcaption]).

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element defines the main content of a document?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [main] element specifies the main content of a document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents a marked or highlighted text?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [mark] element represents text that is marked or highlighted for reference.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for time selection?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The time input type creates a control for entering a time (hour, minute, seconds, fractional seconds).

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for file upload?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The file input type creates a file select field and a 'Browse' button for file uploads.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies the maximum length of text in an input?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The maxlength attribute specifies the maximum number of characters allowed in an input field.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies a minimum value for an input field?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The min attribute specifies the minimum value for an input field.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies that an input field is read-only?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The readonly attribute specifies that an input field is read-only and cannot be modified.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies that an input field must be filled out?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The required attribute specifies that an input field must be filled out before submitting the form.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for URLs?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The url input type is used for input fields that should contain a URL.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which input type is used for search fields?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The search input type is used for search fields (a text field with a clear icon).

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies the visible width of a text input?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The size attribute specifies the visible width, in characters, of an input field.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies a regular expression to check an input against?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The pattern attribute specifies a regular expression that an input field's value is checked against.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies the type of autocomplete functionality?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The autocomplete attribute specifies whether a form or input field should have autocomplete enabled.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies a shortcut key to activate/focus an element?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The accesskey attribute specifies a shortcut key to activate/focus an element.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies whether an element is editable?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The contenteditable attribute specifies whether the content of an element is editable or not.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies the form an element belongs to?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The form attribute specifies which form the element belongs to.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute specifies how the form-data should be encoded?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The enctype attribute specifies how the form-data should be encoded when submitted.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute in audio/video specifies the URL of the media file?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The src attribute specifies the URL of the audio/video file.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute in audio/video enables automatic playing?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The autoplay attribute starts playing the audio/video automatically.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute shows media controls?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The controls attribute adds audio/video controls like play, pause, and volume.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute loads the audio/video when the page loads?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The preload attribute specifies if and how the audio/video should be loaded when the page loads.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element specifies alternative text for audio/video?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [track] element specifies text tracks for audio/video elements.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method is used to draw a rectangle in canvas?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The rect() method creates a rectangle on the canvas.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which property sets the color used for drawing operations?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The strokeStyle property sets the color for drawing operations.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method begins a path in canvas?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The beginPath() method begins a path or resets the current path.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method draws a line to a point in canvas?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The lineTo() method adds a new point and creates a line to that point.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method fills the current drawing?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The fill() method fills the current drawing (path).

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for storing data in web browser?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Web Storage API is used for storing data locally in the browser.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which object stores data with no expiration date?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: localStorage stores data with no expiration date.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which object stores data for one session?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: sessionStorage stores data for one session (data is lost when browser tab is closed).

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method removes an item from storage?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The removeItem() method removes a specific item from storage.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method clears all items in storage?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The clear() method removes all items from storage.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute makes an element draggable?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The draggable attribute makes an element draggable.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which event is fired when dragging starts?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The dragstart event is fired when dragging starts.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which event is fired when dragging ends?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The dragend event is fired when dragging ends.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which event is fired when a dragged element enters a drop target?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The dragenter event is fired when a dragged element enters a drop target.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which event is fired when an element is dropped?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The drop event is fired when an element is dropped.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method gets the current position?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The getCurrentPosition() method gets the current position of the device.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method watches for position changes?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The watchPosition() method watches for changes in position.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which property returns the latitude?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The coords.latitude property returns the latitude.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which property returns the longitude?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The coords.longitude property returns the longitude.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which method clears the watch on position?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The clearWatch() method stops watching for position changes.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element is used to create SVG graphics?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [svg] element is used to define Scalable Vector Graphics.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element creates a circle in SVG?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [circle] element creates a circle in SVG.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element creates a rectangle in SVG?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [rect] element creates a rectangle in SVG.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element creates a line in SVG?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [line] element creates a line in SVG.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute sets the fill color in SVG?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The fill attribute sets the fill color of SVG shapes.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute helps in lazy loading images?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The loading="lazy" attribute enables lazy loading of images.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute preloads resources?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The preload attribute tells the browser to load a resource early.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute hints the browser to prefetch resources?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The prefetch attribute suggests that the browser should fetch a resource.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute defers script execution?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The defer attribute postpones script execution until the document is loaded.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute loads scripts asynchronously?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The async attribute loads and executes scripts asynchronously.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute prevents XSS attacks in forms?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The autocomplete="off" attribute can help prevent XSS attacks in forms.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute sets the content security policy?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The content-security-policy attribute sets security policies for the page.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute prevents clickjacking?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The X-Frame-Options header prevents clickjacking attacks.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute sets CORS policy?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The crossorigin attribute sets CORS policies for elements.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute prevents data leaks in forms?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The autocomplete="off" attribute can prevent sensitive data from being saved.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which practice improves SEO?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Using semantic HTML tags improves SEO and accessibility.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which practice improves accessibility?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Using alt text for images improves accessibility for screen readers.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which practice improves performance?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Lazy loading images improves page load performance.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which practice improves maintainability?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Using semantic HTML tags improves code maintainability.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which practice improves user experience?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: Using proper labels for form elements improves user experience.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute validates email input?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The type="email" attribute validates email input format.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute sets input as required?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The required attribute makes an input field mandatory.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute sets minimum length?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The minlength attribute sets the minimum length for input.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute sets maximum length?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The maxlength attribute sets the maximum length for input.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute sets input pattern?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The pattern attribute sets a regular expression pattern for input validation.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for drawing graphics?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Canvas API is used for drawing graphics on a web page.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for storing data locally?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Web Storage API is used for storing data locally in the browser.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for drag and drop functionality?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The HTML5 Drag and Drop API enables drag and drop functionality.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for getting user's location?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Geolocation API is used to get the user's geographical location.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which API is used for full-screen mode?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The Fullscreen API is used to present web content in full-screen mode.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute provides alternative text for images?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The alt attribute provides alternative text for images for screen readers.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute defines the language of the document?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The lang attribute specifies the language of the document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute describes the role of an element?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The role attribute describes the role of an element for accessibility.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute provides labels for form controls?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The for attribute associates a label with a form control.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute indicates if an element is expanded?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The aria-expanded attribute indicates if an element is expanded or collapsed.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag describes the page content?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The description meta tag provides a description of the page for search engines.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag defines keywords for search engines?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The keywords meta tag specifies keywords for search engines.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag defines the most important heading?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [h1] tag defines the most important heading for SEO.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute helps in URL structure?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The href attribute creates proper URL structure for SEO.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which tag improves semantic structure?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [article] tag improves semantic structure for SEO.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag defines the viewport?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The viewport meta tag defines the viewport for responsive design.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag defines the character encoding?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The charset meta tag defines the character encoding for the document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag controls page refresh?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The refresh meta tag controls automatic page refresh.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag defines the author?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The author meta tag defines the author of the document.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which meta tag controls robots?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The robots meta tag controls search engine crawling and indexing.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents a progress bar?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [progress] element represents a progress bar.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element represents a gauge?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [meter] element represents a gauge or meter.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element defines a time or date?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [time] element defines a time or date.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element defines a command button?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [command] element defines a command button.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which element defines details that can be hidden?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The [details] element defines additional details that can be hidden or shown.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute improves image loading performance?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The loading="lazy" attribute enables lazy loading of images for better performance.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute preloads resources?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The preload attribute tells browsers to download and cache resources for later use.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute hints resource priority?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The fetchpriority attribute hints at the relative priority of resources.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute improves font loading?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The font-display attribute controls how fonts are loaded and displayed.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute defers script execution?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The defer attribute delays script execution until after HTML parsing.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute prevents XSS attacks?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The sandbox attribute restricts potentially malicious content.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which policy header prevents clickjacking?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The X-Frame-Options header prevents clickjacking attacks.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute secures form submission?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The https attribute ensures secure form submission over HTTPS.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute prevents data leaks?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The referrerpolicy attribute controls how much referrer information is sent.

html_mcq_questions.question: Which attribute validates input patterns?
html_mcq_questions.explanation: The pattern attribute validates input against a regular expression.
